data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 静音礼堂里的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【郊外小教堂·清晨】诗乃穿着剪裁简洁的蓝白婚纱站在钢琴旁，黑框眼镜被换成细小的银色发饰；她指尖轻触捧花上的蓝色小花，面对镜头时的安静笑容像一段终于完成的旋律。
data.location: small countryside chapel with an upright piano
data.action: 钢琴旁整理银色发饰并轻触蓝花捧花，安静回眸微笑
data.lighting: clear morning light and pale blue window glow
data.mood: 现实世界里的安静誓约
data.promptProse: Shino Asada from Sword Art Online wears a blue-and-white bridal gown with a simple veil, silver hair ornament and a small blue bouquet. She stands beside the chapel piano with a small blue bouquet resting against her gloves. She touches one blue flower in the bouquet, then looks toward the viewer with a quiet smile as sunlight crosses the polished keys and the veil settles behind her. clear morning light and pale blue window glow.
